items.title: Gregory
items.summary: Gregory is the main protagonist of Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach and a major character of its DLC expansion RUIN.

items.title: The Cat
items.summary: Candy the Cat, also known as The Cat, is the titular secondary antagonist of the Five Nights at Candy's series, acting as the secondary antagonist in Five Nights at Candy's 2 and a major character in Five Nights at Candy's 3.

items.title: The Rat
items.summary: The Rat, also known as RAT, is the main antagonist of the Five Nights at Candy's series, acting as the main antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's and Five Nights at Candy's 2.

items.title: Chester the Chimpanzee
items.summary: Chester the Chimpanzee is a major antagonist in Five Nights at Candy's and Five Nights at Candy's 2.  He is one of the four Classic animatronics of Candy's Burgers & Fries, and acts as a banjoist on his own stage.

items.title: Old Candy
